title: Supabase Project secret key: one-property twin (public-prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix is that of a public sibling identifier rather than the secret. Legacy mutation notes: public-prefix: sb_publishable_ (documented "safe to expose online", supabase.com/docs/guides/api/api-keys) replaces sb_secret_; the 31-character body is unchanged and public-prefix: sb_publishable_ (documented safe to expose) replaces sb_secret_ in the same createClient call; body unchanged. Twin of "Supabase Project secret key: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
